netlify.verdict_rationale: Netlify Edge Functions running Deno runtime support raw L4 TCP dialing via Deno.connect. Live probe confirmed outbound TCP connection to example.com:80 with full read/write echo. However, inbound WebSocket protocol upgrade is rejected by Netlify L7 edge reverse proxy with HTTP 502.

N1.details: Deno.connect is natively exposed in Netlify Edge Functions runtime environment.

N2.details: Successfully dialed example.com:80 via Deno.connect, sent HTTP request, and read response bytes.

N3.details: Netlify L7 CDN Reverse Proxy rejects inbound WebSocket protocol upgrade with HTTP 502. Runtime has Deno.upgradeWebSocket, but edge network terminates connection.

N4.details: Unable to establish WebSocket connection through Netlify edge proxy.

N5.probe_name: WS receive target address and TCP outbound dial
N5.actual_return: Infeasible due to inbound WS handshake rejection
N5.details: Outbound Deno.connect works (proven in N2), but cannot be driven via inbound WebSocket client session.

fastly.verdict_rationale: Fastly provides global Anycast edge routing and VCL reverse proxy to pre-configured origins. Compute service is disabled on this account plan (HTTP 400), and VCL cannot execute dynamic raw TCP dialing. WebSockets product is not enabled on this service. Role is strictly fronting / Anycast ingress.

F1.actual_return: HTTP 400: Your current plan does not include Compute.
F1.details: Wasm compute services cannot be created on this account.

F2.details: Fastly service has active SSL domain configured.

F3.details: WebSockets product is not activated on this service.

F4.actual_return: Fastly forwards HTTP request with Upgrade header to origin backend (Supabase sb1)
F4.details: Under VCL pass, initial HTTP request reaches backend; returns backend HTTP headers.

F5.actual_return: InvalidStatus: server rejected WebSocket connection: HTTP 404
F5.details: Full-duplex WebSocket tunnel cannot be maintained because Fastly WebSockets product is not enabled.

F6.actual_return: Not available in VCL or Compute SDK
F6.details: Fastly VCL is purely L7 HTTP proxy; Compute SDK lacks raw L4 socket primitives.

F7.details: Dynamic backends are disabled on account and only support HTTP/HTTPS origins, not raw TCP.

edgeone.verdict_rationale: EdgeOne Edge Functions run in a pure V8 Isolate without Node net or TCP socket primitives. Node Functions import net fails with HTTP 545. L4 Proxy creation is denied by Tencent Cloud whitelist policy (OperationDenied). Suitable solely for L7 CDN traffic distribution and camouflage.

E1.details: Edge Function can issue outbound HTTP/HTTPS requests via fetch API.

E2.actual_return: HTTP 545 Error return from script: require is not defined
E2.details: Edge Functions runtime does not support Node.js net module.

E3.details: Execution blocked by lack of net module.

E4.details: V8 Isolate runtime lacks inbound WebSocket takeover primitives.

E5.details: Cannot establish or maintain 60s bidirectional WebSocket connection.

E6.details: User account is not on the whitelist for default protection L4 instances.

E7.details: Cannot provision L4 TCP forwarding instances.

E8.details: EdgeOne Site Acceleration L7 CDN supports HTTP and WebSocket origin pass-through via CDN routing.
